{{Quote|The guns are over-heating!|Unidentified clone tank gunner|<ref name="The Deserter" />}}
A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] served as an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] [[Clone gunner/Legends|gunner]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="The Deserter" />

==Biography==
This gunner was part of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] army during the year [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. His walker, like many others, was assigned to find [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] on planet [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]].<ref name="The Deserter" /> This gunner, his walker, and the rest of Kenobi's force marched across the surface of the planet until they found an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] from the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] generals [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]].<ref name="Grievous Intrigue">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref> After finding a relatively undamaged [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]], Kenobi's army found Grievous and began to engage him and his small group of droids. A [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] then came to retrieve the general but was unable to land. Kenobi ordered all of the tanks to fire on the ship. Unfortunately, the walkers main cannons started to over-heat as this gunner pointed out to Kenobi.<ref name="The Deserter" />

==Behind the scenes==
This gunner was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]] like all of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated series.
